description: A bright, resource-driven Phaser match-3 tile game with a layered meadow board, seven-slot tray, animated dealing and elimination, undo, shuffle, remove-three, timeout, restart, and exact refresh recovery. The released free-play mode is local, walletless, and transaction-free. The paid implementation remains unpublished while its Morpheus deal and settlement schemas are aligned and revalidated end to end.
description_zh: 明亮、资源驱动的 Phaser 三消牌槽游戏，拥有多层草地牌面、七格卡槽、发牌与消除动画、撤回、洗牌、移出三张、超时、重开和精确刷新恢复。当前发布的自由练习模式完全本地运行，无需钱包，也不会发起交易。付费实现暂不发布，待 Morpheus 发牌与结算协议完成对齐并重新通过端到端验证后再开放。
name: Sheep Solitaire

operation_panel.subtitle: Choose a meadow route, pick exposed tiles into the seven-slot tray, and match triples before time runs out. Free play never opens a wallet prompt or writes to chain.
operation_panel.title: Sheep Solitaire

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Free play makes no oracle request. The historical recovery implementation remains available, while new paid boards stay gated until end-to-end settlement validation is complete.

tee.description: Free play makes no TEE request. Morpheus-backed paid starts are not advertised until the live signer, session protocol, and contract settlement have production evidence.
